note: Zone of the B23 traffic garden (R_road_01): Le bout de la piste, where the yard meets the countryside, camera facing east. Plane-tree lane, a stream with a rustic wooden footbridge (landmark), two whitewashed sheds, a grassy ditch, the motorway on its embankment by the rocade. Feminine LEFT: squirrel holding a long ruler across the narrow alley between the hangar wall and the plane tree (ruelle); hen laying an egg in the tree-lined lane (allée); duck on the handrail of the footbridge (passerelle); mother hedgehog and three babies crossing the lane in single file (traversée); car with a huge pile of logs on its roof speeding along the motorway (autoroute). Masculine RIGHT: waiter carrying a tiny toy jet on a tray (trajet); fox at the muddy ditch (fossé); golfer in tweed following chalk arrows (parcours); beagle sitting outside the shed door (dehors). Centre/mf: lady cyclist with a small dog in her basket (cycliste). Exits: the open timber hangar on the left -> R_road_04 Le hangar-musée (vintage cab visible inside); the grey path near right -> back to R_road_01. Squirrel moved to the left and the old one removed by local edits. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p4).
